issue.title: capture-complete: an unclosed [[ wikilink field replaces through end of line, deleting trailing text on accept

task_type_fields.impact: Bob Mac Capture applies bob's byte range verbatim. Any link inserted before existing text on the same line (a common edit in task text, sub-bullets, and Work Log summaries) silently deletes that text, and can swallow capture markers such as @route. It also blocks reusing capture-complete for prose fields (event notes, reasons).
task_type_fields.location: src/native/capture_links.rs (completion_field_at / wikilink note field inner_end for unclosed links)
task_type_fields.repro:
Reproduced with installed bob 0.5.0 against the repo's `vault/` fixture (the real vault gives the same range):

```
bob capture-complete -b vault -c 9 -f json -- 'Read [[da because of the outage'
→ {"context":"wikilink_note","replacement":{"start":7,"end":31},
   "candidates":[{"replacement":"day]]","cursor_after":12,"path":"day.md",...}]}
```

When a `[[` link is unclosed, the replacement range runs from the end of `[[` to the end of the line (7..31), not to the caret (9). Accepting the only candidate turns the draft into `Read [[day]]` and silently deletes ` because of the outage`. A read-only survey saw the same with `Read [[da foo @inbox`: the completion range was 7..20, so accepting a row would also overwrite the `@inbox` route marker. Obsidian's own editor replaces only from `[[` to the caret.

Likely root cause: `src/native/capture_links.rs`, around `completion_field_at` and the note-field `inner_start..inner_end` computation at roughly :572-593. When no closing `]]` follows on the line, `inner_end` falls back to the end of the line. The fix: an unclosed field ends at the caret. Closed links keep today's behavior of replacing through the existing `]]`. Add regression vectors with trailing prose and a trailing `@route` marker. Add a contract note in `docs/capture.md` (replacement range for `wikilink_*` contexts).

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching [[ wikilink completion for Bob prose prompts: inserting a link mid-sentence in the Mac capture panel deletes everything after the caret, which is silent data loss.
